title: What the Sunset Moth lights

is_this_you.pressure: The leaf that raised you was poison. You kept every drop, and nothing tries you twice.
is_this_you.love: You want to be seen in full sun and named right. Get your colour exact and you will cross an island for them.
is_this_you.cost: You cross the whole island for the one thing that feeds you, and forget to ask whether it still does.

opener.text: In Malagasy, one word, lolo, means both butterfly and ghost, the spirit of someone who has died [s7] [s6]. Malagasy belief holds that the souls of ancestors can come back as moths or butterflies, so harming one harms the ancestors [s6]. The sunset moth lives nowhere but Madagascar [s6]. You were born a Leo in a Rooster year. People have always felt you arrived from somewhere. They look twice when you land.

howto: Three parts, each in its own light.

tabs.label: First light
tabs.intro: Fire ruled by the Sun. Metal that answers it.

rows.text: Leo is fixed Fire, ruled by the Sun, warm, generous, bold and theatrical [s1] [s2]. The Rooster is yin Metal, observant, honest and true to its promises [s3] [s4]. Both halves of you face the sun. You turn up early, fully lit, and you keep your word about it.

Unlike most moths, the sunset moth flies by day [s6]. The colour on its wings comes from no pigment; tiny structures in the scales bend the light, so the colour shifts with the angle you see it from [s6]. Most of your relatives keep to the dark. You came out at noon, and you look different to everyone watching.
Recorded local names for this moth, adriandolo and lolonandriana, join lolo with andriana, noble [s6]. A noble spirit. A king butterfly. The Leo in you heard that and was not surprised.

The caterpillar eats only Omphalea, a toxic plant, and keeps the poison through the pupa into the adult [s6]. You kept what was hard about your beginning too. It is part of why nothing troubles you for long.

When the plants change, thousands of adults migrate between scattered stands of Omphalea across Madagascar [s6]. You will travel that far for what feeds you. Loyal to the one source, never to one patch of forest.
In Victorian Europe its wings were set into jewellery, and it is still collected for the butterfly trade [s6]. People will try to wear your shine. Let them admire it from where they stand.
Work where daylight finds you. Broadcasting, presenting and public relations suit the Rooster [s4], and Leo takes a stage gladly [s2].

tabs.label: Who you glow for
tabs.intro: Three who see your true colour. One who sees the wrong one.
tabs.love_lead: In love you are generous, you show it [s2], and you keep every promise [s4]. You need someone who names your exact colour. The old pairings light up three.

easy.why: The Sand Cat (Sagittarius, Snake year) shares your trine of Ox, Snake and Rooster, and Sagittarius is Fire like you [s5] [s1].
The Arctic Tern (Sagittarius, Ox year) completes that trine and burns with the same Fire [s5] [s1].
The Frigatebird (Sagittarius, Dragon year) is your secret friend, since the Dragon is the Rooster's hidden ally [s5].

hard.why: The Axolotl (Aquarius, Rabbit year) keeps seeing the wrong colour: the Rabbit clashes with the Rooster, and Aquarius sits opposite Leo [s5] [s1].

story.text: An old Chinese book, the Xuanzhongji, 玄中記 (Xuánzhōngjì), tells of a giant peach tree called Taodu, 桃都 (táo dū), with a heavenly rooster, 天雞 (tiān jī), in its branches [s10]. When the first sun strikes the tree, the heavenly rooster crows, and every rooster under heaven answers [s10].

closing: First sun on the forest. Open your wings, and let the whole island answer.
